evidence.quote: 3SUN Gigafactory is Europe’s only facility for the production of photovoltaic cells and modules, distinguished by a high level of automation and advanced manufacturing processes that ensure quality, efficiency, and global competitiveness. || 3 GW of installed production capacity || commercial and industrial (C&I) projects, utility-scale installations, and residential applications
